 Setting to mute the game upon exiting its window

notes.title: Update 08.02.2024
notes.notes:
Wanderers, the new update changes are here!

We’ve added quest change notifications, a  „J” shortcut to access the journal, and a heartbeat sound when the caravan's charge drops to 0% — cool, right? How about adding the same heartbeat sound for battles against troll gangs? 👀

See the full changelog below:

Added:

 Quest change notifications
 Keyboard shortcut "J" to access the journal
 Tutorial step on the prepare screen
 Heartbeat sound when caravan charge drops to 0%


Improved:

 Fight levels
 Screen dimming during tutorial displays
 Consistent music on hexes under the city
 Improved lock disappearance during transitions
 Recharge widget in the camp
 Inventory visuals
 Showing of inventory changes during events


Fixed:

 Wrong drag-and-drop item size
 Issue causing quest log not to display after camp’s ambush
 Ability to setup the camp in the city or at a POIs
 Crashfix for the NL_Continue event in Mine
 Other minor fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Devlog #1 Demo release and game development so far
notes.notes:
Welcome, Wanderers, to our first Devlog!

First, we would like to thank you for participating in the Nashlax's stream as part of the Steam Next Fest event. A lot of you seemed to enjoyed it - we feel like we have a solid base and can now focus on polishing and adding additional content into the game to make it even more fun.

In this post, we'll take you through the process we've gone through to get to where we are today, as seen in the released demo.

Wanderer's Sigil was first announced more than six months ago. A lot has changed since then!

New biomes that interact with the game’s storyline, new structures, quests, events and a lot of changes to the procedurally generated map. The addition of „tunneling” requires from players to plan their route strategically and navigate smartly. In the latest update, we have also divided the map into story chapters and added a compass to make it easier to reach quests or return to town. Be careful, as it is easy to get lost or into trouble due to the darkness that comes when the crystal's energy drops!

Old vs new exploration:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/cb29e4d4bc8d62931c0e73945accbc9368b6645d.png

Icons of opponents on the map have been removed. They have been replaced by models of opponents standing on the ground. We are currently working on improving the mechanics that allow enemies to move around the map after a certain number of player turns. However, such mechanics can cause balance issues, so this is a change we have in mind for the future.

Old vs new enemies on the map:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/d8b82bf5aeb8d8709ae7a09e351049102bf9e2dd.png

Updated combat system with the addition of the ability to drag a selected die onto an opponent and the option to change characters formation, that opens up new strategic possibilities for those who focus on creating specific builds. We have recently introduced a variety of combat levels that reflect the biome in which the combat takes place.

Combat levels depending on biomes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/4bdb7e94a020b4423b3c16665cc104496fb71cd2.gif

Dice have also been redesigned, improving the readability of special skill markers.

Old vs new dice:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/d72ea266a807351ed4270f1af3a4f44b20c67b60.png

We have expanded the mechanics of the camp by adding the possibility to resurrect a fallen wanderer. After all, you don't want to see your allies get zombified forever, do you?

Revive available in camp:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/e2801d51e09b0e6427f9aaec34d8c502346edffe.png

And, as a treat for reading so far, take a look at how the game looked at the very beginning. We've sure come a long way!

Earliest version of Wanderer's Sigil
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306375/da39bc250211f3e31f56d2546e7a4d08419a625e.png

We hope you enjoyed this Devlog - more updates are coming soon.

Stay safe, Wanderers!
